import java.io.*;

public class Main {
    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        String[] firstLine = br.readLine().split(" ");
        int n = Integer.parseInt(firstLine[0]);
        int m = Integer.parseInt(firstLine[1]);
        String[] aStr = br.readLine().split(" ");
        int[] a = new int[n];
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            a[i] = Integer.parseInt(aStr[i]);
        }

        int mid_point = n / 2;
        List<Integer> partA = new ArrayList<>();

        // Generate all subset sums for first half

        // Generate all subset sums for second half
        getSums2(a, mid_point, 0, 0, m, n, partB);

        Collections.sort(partA);
        int best_sum = 0;

        for (int val : partB) {
            int index = Collections.binarySearch(partA, m - val);
            if (index < 0) {
                index = -index - 1; // insertion point
            }
            if (index > 0) {
                int candidate = partA.get(index - 1) + val;
                if (candidate > best_sum) {
                    best_sum = candidate;
                }
            }
        }
        System.out.println(best_sum);
    }

    }

    private static void getSums2(int[] a, int i, int total, int m, int n, List<Integer> partB) {

        } else {
            getSums2(a, i + 1, (total + a[i]) % m, m, n, partB);
            getSums2(a, i + 1, total, m, n, partB);
        }
